product_family: AI-powered data retrieval and natural language querying platform for financial and enterprise data. Core products: LLM-ready API, Kensho Scribe (transcription), Kensho NERD (entity recognition), Core AI Capabilities (ML/NLP). Primary use: structured financial data access via LLM integrations.

privacy.ai_training_note: Customer data is NOT used to train Kensho's general AI models. For proprietary data partnerships (e.g., Tegus transcription case study), Kensho uses disassociated processing with speaker embeddings stripped of identifying information before model training. API customers retain full data ownership; S&P Global does not see natural language queries, only API code.
privacy.data_region: UK and EU residency capabilities available; data transfer via Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) where required

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: HTTPS with TLS 1.2 or later for all data in transit

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: No public specification found; general S&P Global safeguards mentioned

security.name: Authentication
security.value: Public-Private keypair authentication (recommended for production) and personal token authentication available; tokens refreshed hourly

security.name: Data access controls
security.value: S&P Global does not receive or see natural language questions, only API code; clients own their data; no access to MNPI (material non-public information)

security.name: Security approach
security.value: Build with safeguards from the start; pilot internally before scaling externally; continuous improvement via real-world feedback

products.name: LLM-ready API
products.data_scope: S&P Global structured financial datasets; customer data NOT retained or used for training
products.notes: Allows querying S&P Global financial data via LLM integrations (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini). Customers retain ownership of queries and data. No access to customer MNPI.

products.name: Kensho Scribe
products.data_scope: Customer audio transcription; anonymized data used for model improvement (speaker embeddings only)
products.notes: AI-powered business audio transcription with 99%+ accuracy. Uses disassociated processing for quality improvement without exposing identifying information.

products.name: Kensho NERD
products.data_scope: Proprietary S&P Global data; customer data not used
products.notes: Named entity recognition and disambiguation for financial/business text. Helps identify sensitive information (MNPI, client names) for removal.

products.name: Core AI Capabilities
products.data_scope: Proprietary S&P Global data for model training
products.notes: ML/NLP building blocks for structuring and enriching proprietary data. Not offered as a consumer service.

compare.pricing_model: Enterprise SaaS; API-based usage; contact sales for pricing
compare.data_residency: UK and EU residency available; US default
